verdict.rationale: Stable's virtual-mailbox pages advertise a check-deposit action ('Deposit: Automate check deposits', 'deposit checks'). The API docs include a Check object for checks transcribed from mail, so the core deposit capability is the product's own. The deposit claims are marketing-level, though, and nothing explains how checks are endorsed, routed to the customer's own bank, or reconciled. Missing for 10: documented endorsement handling, confirmation of deposit to the customer's bank account, reconciliation or matching of deposits, plan availability of deposit (basic plan lists only scan/ship/shred), independent or hands-on corroboration.
